backup.production_rule: Expand only: five new functions (intake_resolve_v1, intake_uploads_today_v1 owner-only; intake_guest_context_v1, intake_save_guest_details_v1, intake_save_guest_companion_v1 service_role only), all security definer with an empty search_path. No table, column, policy, bucket or data change; the guest-id-photos bucket, its three staff policies and the SPEC-40 purge trigger are untouched. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

forward_verification.name: five_functions_definer_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 5 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('intake_resolve_v1','intake_uploads_today_v1','intake_guest_context_v1','intake_save_guest_details_v1','intake_save_guest_companion_v1')

forward_verification.name: three_rpcs_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.intake_guest_context_v1(text)','execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.intake_save_guest_details_v1(text,jsonb)','execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.intake_save_guest_companion_v1(text,text,text,text,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.intake_guest_context_v1(text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.intake_save_guest_companion_v1(text,text,text,text,text)','execute')

forward_verification.name: internal_helpers_not_callable_and_public_holds_nothing
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('service_role','public.intake_resolve_v1(text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role','public.intake_uploads_today_v1(uuid,text)','execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname like 'intake\_%' and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: id_photo_bucket_and_policies_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select (select not public and file_size_limit = 10485760 from storage.buckets where id = 'guest-id-photos') and (select count(*) = 3 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname like 'guest id photos %')

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261007_guest_intake.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the five functions. Companions, ID photos and history rows the form already wrote stay (staff see them in the dashboard). Roll the stay-site (stay.html) and the guest-intake function back too.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_function_then_site
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release FIRST, then deploy guest-intake (verify_jwt false; config.toml and edge-auth-manifest entries are in the waves commit), then publish stay-site. An out-of-order deploy fails safe: stay.html asks guest-intake for the form, and any 404, 503 or network error simply leaves the Before you arrive section out; the status page is unchanged. guest-access, submit-booking and telegram-expense are not touched. guest-intake bundles _shared/guest-access-token.ts, _shared/observability.ts and _shared/cascade-core/format.ts: redeploy it if any of those change (Hard Rule 9).

compatibility.rehearsal: PENDING - run pgTAP guest_intake (57 tests) and the rollback body on a restored backup before apply. Expected on a --no-acl restore (B103): the function-EXECUTE assertions (tests 2-5) fail by design because that backup cannot carry grants; the CI database job proves them. Do not weaken the suite. The suite was written without a local Postgres (Docker was down), so this rehearsal is its first run: read any failure as a possible test bug first.
compatibility.evidence: Read from the repo 2026-10-07: guest_access_tokens (booking_type direct or airbnb, token_hash unique, RLS on, service_role only), booking_inquiries.guest_id is set by upsert_guest_for_booking at submit, guest_companions and guest_profile_details shapes and their history tables (changed_by nullable), the guest-id-photos bucket (private, 10 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP) with three manage_operations policies (migration 20260914260000) and the purge trigger (20261005130000). The RPCs reuse the telegram_save_guest_* validation (names, contact, ID type, path pattern, 12 people cap) and add the token gate.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run pgTAP guest_intake.sql green on this commit
guest-intake is deployed before this release is applied
